splash.headline: This is your Semblance.
splash.tagline: Your intelligence. Your device. Your rules.
splash.subtext: A digital representation that understands your world, acts on your behalf, and is architecturally incapable of betraying your trust.

hardware.headline: Checking your hardware
hardware.subtext: Semblance will recommend the best model for your machine.

data_sources.headline: Connect your world
data_sources.subtext: Everything stays on this device. Semblance connects to your accounts through the Gateway, fetches your data, and stores it locally.
data_sources.more_sources: + 42 more sources available in Connections after setup
data_sources.privacy_notice: Your data never leaves this device. Connections are encrypted and revocable at any time.
data_sources.nudge: Connecting at least one source helps Semblance understand your world. You can always add more later.

autonomy.headline: How much should Semblance do on its own?
autonomy.subtext: You can change this anytime in Settings. Most users start with Partner.
autonomy.alter_ego_note: Alter Ego mode is available after you build trust with Partner. You can upgrade anytime in Settings.

guardian.name: Guardian
guardian.description: Shows everything, asks before acting. You approve every action.

partner.name: Partner
partner.description: Handles routine tasks autonomously. Asks for anything new or high-stakes.

alter_ego.name: Alter Ego
alter_ego.description: Acts as you across your digital life. Confirms before irreversible actions, high-stakes decisions, and anything above your financial threshold. Everything else: handled.

naming_moment.headline: What should it call you?
naming_moment.privacy_notice: Stored only on your device. Never transmitted.
naming_moment.confirmation: Your Semblance will address you as {{name}}. You can change this in Settings.

naming_ai.headline: What will you call it?
naming_ai.subtext: This is what your AI will be called. You can change it in Settings.

intent.goal_headline: What’s your primary reason for using Semblance?
intent.goal_subtext: This helps it understand how to prioritize on your behalf.
intent.goal_placeholder: e.g. Get on top of my work so I have more time for family
intent.limit_headline: Is there anything you’d never want Semblance to do without asking first?
intent.limit_subtext: You can add more limits anytime in Settings.
intent.limit_placeholder: e.g. Never send emails on my behalf without showing me first
intent.value_headline: What matters most to you that most people wouldn’t know?
intent.value_subtext: Semblance uses this to make better decisions on your behalf.
intent.value_placeholder: e.g. I always prioritize my kids' schedules over work commitments

initialize.downloading_subtext: Downloading models and preparing your knowledge graph. This may take a few minutes.
initialize.ready_subtext: Connect more data sources later to unlock deeper insights.
initialize.continue_warnings_detail: Some models failed to download. You can continue, but features requiring {{models}} won't work until you download them in Settings → AI Engine.
initialize.no_data_message: Connect a data source to see your Knowledge Moment — your first taste of compound intelligence.

alter_ego_week_offer.headline: Unlock Alter Ego Week?
alter_ego_week_offer.description: Alter Ego Week is a 7-day trust-building sequence. Each day, Semblance demonstrates a new autonomous capability — email triage, calendar intelligence, file organization, and more. At the end, you decide whether to grant full autonomy.
alter_ego_week_offer.settings_note: You can always enable Alter Ego Week later in Settings → Alter Ego Week.
alter_ego_week_offer.skip_button: Skip — I'll explore on my own

initial_index.headline: Indexing your data...
initial_index.subtext: Semblance is building your knowledge graph from your connected sources. This runs in the background.
initial_index.complete_subtext: {{count}} items indexed across your connected sources.
